exactK_and_duplicates: K=n uses explicit singleton endpoint for all matched constructors; not claimed to be native sklearn result. If distinct feature vectors<requestedK, library is fitted at min(K,distinct), then largest group (tie smallest original position) repeatedly splits off its last member until exactK. Any other missing labels repaired same way. Repair counts/warnings reported. Thus duplicate-repaired cases are declared adaptations of standard clustering, not silently official outputs. Native LDLKM uses actual nonempty groups with no exactK repair.

native_LDLKM.implementation_disclosures: Training-only min-max scaling, sklearn1.8.0 Lloyd random initialization, tol1e-4 and fixed seed; these are explicit implementation choices, not claimed verbatim paper specifications. Feature and label means per nonempty cluster. Softmax of inverse Minkowski5 distances over all centers. Zero-distance rows: equal weight only among exactzero centers; an added convention because paper reciprocal is undefined there. Stable inverse-logit shifting. Native alpha0 output and separately named half-mean adaptation both reported. Native uses U/no information geometry; same selected P, K5 or fewer distinct centers. Model byte count includes selected indices,scaling,feature and label centers, plus prior only for half-adaptation. No complete deployment/hardware-memory claim.

replay_boundary: Existing geometric and oldLloyd, alpha.5 fixed curves and cap100 policies use E07 splits and should replay exactly. Replayed rows are not new independent evidence.
